subject: [RESEND v7 08/29] mm: recognize PMD swap entries in the softleaf layer

reviews.author: David (Arm)
reviews.summary: Reviewer questioned the usefulness of a VM_WARN_ON_ONCE check in softleaf_to_page(), pointing out that it's redundant due to another identical check in softleaf_to_pfn().
reviews.raw_body:
Heh, and in softleaf_to_pfn() we have another

	VM_WARN_ON_ONCE(!softleaf_has_pfn(entry));

So the one in softleaf_to_page() is rather useless already? :)

-- 
Cheers,

David

2026-09-22.patch_summary: This patch modifies the softleaf layer to recognize PMD swap entries, addressing a warning that occurs when trying to access a non-present PMD as if it were a valid page. The change is made in response to zap_huge_pmd(), which is the only current path that reaches this condition. By recognizing PMD swap entries, the patch prevents unnecessary warnings and ensures correct behavior in this scenario.
